reviews.text: Community. I don’t go outside much because the world scares me. However, I always try to make Sunday yoga - it helps keep things in check, physically and mentally, and it’s nice to be and see familiar faces.

Longmont Yoga Pod. The Longmont pod is staffed with the best teachers, all of them are excellent, the studio itself is always clean and welcoming, the variety of offerings accommodates all schedules and interests, and the location from my house can't be beat. So much gratitude for this Longmont gem.
Greatest yoga studio!. Yoga Pod is an amazing studio. The instructors are the best and there are plenty of classes offered every day. I love the flexibility of the three locations

Very great app. This app makes it really handy for me to schedule classes… Both in Studio and virtual.

I appreciate that it is very clear when the booking is finalized.

… And it is accompanied by a calendar notification to confirm the booking… 

 finally… If you are doing a virtual class, you then get a subsequent email with the Zoom link.
It flows very nicely … even if you are scheduling last minute

reviews.text: They Care. Best of Boulder for nearly a decade - and for good reason! They really care about their members. They know your name, make you feel welcome, and many of their instructors have been there for years, a decade, or from the beginning. They know how to take care of people.

Yoga Pod Rocks. Love love love this yoga studio!!!
Thank you yoga Pod
Designed exactly how I want it to be. Seldom (perhaps never) has an app been this simple, intuitive, supportive, and well maintained. Thank you!

reviews.text: Just sign up and go. “When the student is ready, the teacher appears.” YogaPod has helped me fundamentally improve my life on several levels. Great community. Clean studios. Huge variety of classes all day.

I love YogaPod. The teachers are kind, fun and thoughtful. Other practitioners are dedicated to deepening their practice and their lives. I love being a part of it. ❤️

Yoga Pod is my go to indoor workout. The app is great because it shows all 3 locations. Being in outside sales I can select the location & time that are best for my day. 
If I need a heated, flow, yin class it is all there @ my finger tips.
